title: Implementing the Cardano Foundation Identity Wallet in Landano

ms.promise:
1. Detailed design specifications document for the Identity Wallet wrapper.
 2. A functional Mendix prototype showcasing preliminary integration capabilities with the Cardano Foundation Identity Wallet using the KERI protocol.
ms.criteria:
• Approval of the design specifications document by the project review committee.
 • Successful demonstration of the Mendix prototype in a controlled test environment, illustrating integration capabilities with the Cardano Foundation Identity Wallet.
ms.report:
Achievement of this milestone is to be judged according to the accomplishment of these two criteria:
・Approval of the design specifications document by the project review committee.
・Successful demonstration of the Mendix prototype in a controlled test environment, illustrating integration capabilities with the Cardano Foundation Identity Wallet.

Evidence of achievement of these two criteria have been manifested thusly:
・Publication of the design document on the official Landano project website.
・Video recording of the prototype demonstration, uploaded to the Landano project’s official YouTube channel or website.

We have published the design specs document as approved by the project review committee, as well as a link to a video demonstrating the prototype's preliminary integration capabilities, at the official project website: 
https://docs.landano.io/d/landano-veridian-integration
Thank you!

 2. Updated prototype that meets all functional requirements as outlined in the initial design document.

 • Confirmation from the technical team that the updated prototype meets the predefined functional requirements.
